# Student component templates

These six files are the documented starting point for catalog projects that use
the corresponding components. Run
`python3 scripts/sync_student_component_templates.py` after changing one of
them. The course tests verify that each project receives the same starting
guidance for every component it declares.

**Start another challenge…** copies compatible student work into a separate
selected project after showing the file changes. These templates are used when
a selected project needs a component that is not present in the source project.
